basic_info.description: A Meticulously crafted,3-story 5BR/3BA luxury home  with 1BR/1BA accessory dwelling unit (ADU). The main level features an open floor plan that seamlessly connects the kitchen, living, and dining areas. Gleaming Oak hardwood floors, recessed lighting, and Marvin windows throughout. The chef's kitchen is outfitted with a gorgeous center island, custom Eclipse cabinetry, Fisher & Paykel electric appliances, and luxurious porcelain counter-tops. The main level also includes two bedrooms and two full bathrooms and a laundry closet for added utility and convenience.Upstairs, the private primary en-suite serves as a true retreat, featuring a soaking tub, dual vanities, and a custom walk-in closet, the perfect place to unwind. The upper level also has two additional bedrooms,step out deck and a full bathroom. The home features an expansive rooftop deck that delivers panoramic views of Lake Merced & Golf Course, making it the perfect oasis for entertaining and relaxing.The ADU, with private entrance, and overlooking the beautiful rear landscaped yard is ideal for extended family, guests or as rental unit.Additional features: ADU Separate Utility Meter, Solar Panels,Powerwall,Security System,Ductless MiniSplit, Exterior lighting, 1Car Garage + ample street parking. Ready for occupancy!
